signed_rows.behavior: kmctl check --fix writes each Diataxis folder's README.md from its pages: a marker comment saying kmctl writes it, then one entry per page with its H1 title as link text and its description front matter when present; it changes no other file, and a second run changes nothing.

signed_rows.behavior: kmctl check fails (exit 1) with exactly one error when a Diataxis folder has no README.md or its index differs from what kmctl would generate, with a fix naming kmctl check --fix; a page directly in docs/ or outside the four folders that docs/README.md does not list is still an error.
